args.sql:
SELECT p.uuid, p.babylon_guid, p.status, p.provisioned_at, p.modified_at, u.email AS owner_email, p.catalog_id
FROM provisions p
JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.babylon_guid = 'hx7rv'
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.uuid, p.babylon_guid, p.status, p.provisioned_at, p.modified_at, p.ordered_by, p.catalog_id
FROM provisions p
WHERE p.babylon_guid = 'hx7rv'
LIMIT 5
